# Screenshot & Design to Code

Turn screenshots and mockups into code, give text-only agents eyes, and present code nicely. Plus the dashboard style gallery to pick a look from.

[← All categories](README.md)

<a id="dashboard-gallery"></a>
### Dashboard style gallery

`docs/dashboards/README.md + catalog/dashboards.json` · reference · **core** · phases: Direction, Design, Build

Complete, themeable reference dashboards grouped by style family and use case. Pick one as the starting look, then map it onto the toolkit tokens.

**Use when**
- Choosing a visual direction for any dashboard
- The client points at a screenshot and says “like this”
- Adding a new reference dashboard from a screenshot

**Avoid when**
- Copying a gallery dashboard 1:1 into a client product without adapting words, data and brand

**How to use**
- Filter catalog/dashboards.json by use_cases, style_family and mode; show the human 2–3 thumbnails
- Read the chosen entry’s layout, components and signature; reuse its style.css tokens as the project’s theme
- To add one: follow docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md exactly

**Pairs with:** [screenshot-to-code](design-to-code.md#screenshot-to-code) · [Frontend Design](uiux.md#frontend-design) · [Creative Direction](brand.md#creative-direction)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/dashboards/README.md](../../docs/dashboards/README.md)

**Docs:** https://github.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/blob/main/docs/dashboards/README.md

<a id="screenshot-to-code"></a>
### screenshot-to-code

`github.com/abi/screenshot-to-code (local app, docker compose)` · cli · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build

Turns a screenshot, mockup or screen recording into HTML/Tailwind, React or Vue with a vision model. MIT.

**Use when**
- Getting a fast first draft of a layout from a screenshot
- Measuring structure (grid, spacing) before hand-building

**Avoid when**
- Shipping its raw output: it hard-codes colors and sizes; always refactor to tokens
- No model API key available (it needs OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini keys)

**How to use**
- Run locally (docker compose up) with your own API key in backend/.env
- Choose “HTML + CSS” for gallery dashboards; treat the result as a sketch
- Rebuild the result in site/dashboards/<id>/ with token variables, original copy and code-drawn art

**Pairs with:** [Dashboard style gallery](design-to-code.md#dashboard-gallery) · [Design2Code](design-to-code.md#design2code) · [ScreenCoder](design-to-code.md#screencoder)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md](../../docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md)

**Requires:** Vision model API key

**Docs:** https://github.com/abi/screenshot-to-code

<a id="screencoder"></a>
### ScreenCoder

`github.com/leigest519/ScreenCoder (Python)` · cli · **optional** · phases: Design, Build

Research multi-agent UI-to-code pipeline: detects layout blocks, maps components, generates HTML/CSS. Apache-2.0.

**Use when**
- Complex screenshots where block detection helps get the grid right

**Avoid when**
- Quick jobs; setup is heavier than screenshot-to-code

**How to use**
- Use its block detection output as a layout map; hand-build the dashboard on tokens

**Pairs with:** [screenshot-to-code](design-to-code.md#screenshot-to-code)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md](../../docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md)

**Requires:** Python + model API key

**Docs:** https://github.com/leigest519/ScreenCoder

<a id="agent-vision-toolkit"></a>
### agent-vision-toolkit

`github.com/Anionex/agent-vision-toolkit` · cli · **situational** · phases: Design, Build, Polish & QA

Vision CLIs plus a skill that give text-only coding agents image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration and GUI automation. MIT.

**Use when**
- Your coding agent runs on a text-only model and must read screenshots

**Avoid when**
- The agent already sees images (Claude, Devin with vision)

**How to use**
- Install its CLIs; ask it to describe layout, colors and text of each screenshot before building

**Pairs with:** [screenshot-to-code](design-to-code.md#screenshot-to-code)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md](../../docs/dashboards/01-add-a-dashboard.md)

**Docs:** https://github.com/Anionex/agent-vision-toolkit

### draw-ui (skill, reference)

`github.com/oil-oil/draw-ui` · reference · **situational** · phases: Direction, Design

Agent skill that settles page goal and visual direction before generating a UI design, then rebuilds it as HTML. No license file: study the workflow, don’t copy its text.

**Use when**
- Learning a design-first workflow: confirm page goal, references and locked regions before drawing

**Avoid when**

**How to use**
